# Notes for Copilot CLI in the PostgreSQL MCP lab

The rules of this lab are in `AGENTS.md`. This file only adds what is specific to using the lab with Copilot CLI.

## Which MCP server to use

| Server (from `.mcp.json`) | Use it for | Access |
|---|---|---|
| `pg-crystaldba-restricted` | exploring the schema, SQL, EXPLAIN, hypothetical indexes, index advice | read-only |
| `pg-reference` | the plain `query` tool; shows what a basic read-only server offers | read-only |
| `pg-toolbox` | fixed, approved reports only (no free SQL) | read-only |
| `pg-crystaldba-unrestricted` | DDL from an approved migration, after the user confirms | can change the schema |

Default to a read-only server. Say which server you use. Never use the unrestricted server to get around a block.

## Agents and skills in this repository

- Custom agents (`/agent`): `data-analyst` (read-only questions and reviews) and `dba` (tuning and migrations, with confirmation before any change).
- Skills: `schema-guide`, `nl-to-sql`, `sql-safety-review`, `explain-tuning`, `migration-author`.
- A `preToolUse` hook (`guard-sql`) denies DROP, TRUNCATE and UPDATE or DELETE without WHERE, and any change statement or multi-statement call on the read-only servers. If it blocks you, report it.

## Schema changes

Put every schema change in `db/migrations/NNN_name.up.sql` and `.down.sql`, and apply it with `scripts/apply-sql.sh` or `scripts/apply-sql.ps1` after the user confirms.
